scope.summary: Implement BVH/FBX/glTF mocap ingestion with bone-map presets per Section 13.18 (BK-18.3, TAI-BK-067), closing AREQ-004 and GREQ-036: skeletal animation ingest with named bone-map presets (Mixamo, Rokoko, UE, Unity, Daz, VRM naming conventions) plus auto-detection of the source convention; FBX ingest may route through the existing Blender-bridge conversion lane (13.12) — the native-FBX-writer prohibition is unaffected (ingest only). Emits TailorBodyMocapIngested with source format and preset in the payload.
acceptance_criteria: ingest_mocap(path, preset: Option<BoneMapPreset>) parses BVH natively and glTF skeletal animation natively; FBX routes through the existing Blender-bridge import lane (reuse assertion: no new FBX parser, and no FBX WRITER anywhere).

Bone-map presets ship for Mixamo, Rokoko, UE, Unity, Daz, and VRM naming conventions as data (JSON preset files mapping source bone names to canonical BodyKit bones), not code; unknown source bones are reported, not dropped silently.

Auto-detection: when preset is None, source bone names are scored against all presets and the best match above a documented threshold is chosen; below threshold is a typed AmbiguousBoneMap error listing candidates.

Ingested clips land as typed BodyAnimClip (bone track curves against a skeleton version) ready for the MT-524 retarget engine; a Mixamo-named BVH fixture ingests end-to-end onto the canonical skeleton.
TailorBodyMocapIngested is registered and emitted with { source_format, bone_map_preset, clip_id }.
scope.risk_if_missed: Mocap is the cheapest source of natural motion for animation loops; without convention-aware ingest every clip needs hand bone-mapping, and a hidden native FBX writer sneaking in here would violate the standing 13.12 prohibition the whole export architecture is built around.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
